description: This file defines data models related to chat functionality in an Android application, including message contents, sessions, history, and attachments.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with an ID, role, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content of a chat message, such as text or files.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Models a pending call to a tool within the chat context.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry for a chat session with key and display info.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Encapsulates the message history within a chat session.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment to be sent as part of a chat message.
